BEHIND THE NUMBER

A guide for your ears

The score compares audio features from your selected excerpts. It is a useful starting point, not a probability that listeners will enjoy the transition.

Harmony · 35%
Similarity of pitch-class energy (chroma). This measures shared tonal content, not melodic phrasing or a reliable musical key.
Tempo · 25%
Estimated pulse from energy changes. Half-time and double-time are treated as compatible. Sparse or beatless audio can be uncertain.
Energy · 20%
The gap in average loudness (RMS) between the excerpts.
Texture · 20%
Similarity in spectral brightness and high-frequency content.

These features describe the selected source audio. Changing the fade curve or duration changes the preview, but does not change this score. Silence and very short excerpts cannot be scored reliably.

Deep learning: not connected

This prototype uses signal analysis. A learned score would require a trained audio model and evaluation against human-rated transitions.

Music services: manual handoff

Playlists here are device-local. Spotify and Apple Music links open a song search; they do not add tracks automatically. Direct sync requires developer setup and account authorization. Streaming-service audio is not imported or mixed.
